title: Compression candidate state diagram
description: The status column of one row in the state file's cands table, which compress reads as compress::Cand. The scan inserts a row as pending; compress moves it once, to done, skipped or failed, and never back. A dry run, a failed ditto probe (compress stops before touching any row when ditto --hfsCompression writes an uncompressed test copy), a stop request or the three-failure abort leaves the remaining rows pending. The row goes only when the whole state file is replaced by a new scan; list --status shows any of the four.

states.description: Recorded by the scan with its size, allocated size, estimated saving, mtime and inode; waiting for compress.
Compressed in place; saved holds the verified drop in allocated size.
Left as it was, with a note why: gone, changed, flagged, recently modified, open, directory not writable, not enough free space for the temp copy, APFS declined, or gain below --min-gain.
A verification or I/O step failed; the original is untouched and the note says which step.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the ditto probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: precheck passes; ditto succeeds; the copy is compressed, saves at least --min-gain, matches size, mode, owner, group and SHA-256, and keeps the original's xattr names; the original is unchanged since
transitions.action: Restore the times on the temp copy, rename it over the original, write status done and the saving.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the ditto probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: precheck finds a reason, APFS did not compress the copy, the gain is below --min-gain, or the original changed during compression
transitions.action: Remove the temp copy; write status skipped and the note.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the ditto probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: ditto fails, or size, permissions or ownership differ, xattrs were lost, the hash differs, or an I/O error occurs
transitions.action: Remove the temp copy; write status failed and the note; after three failures in a row stop the run.
